name: Opportunist / Investigator
life_theme: Build expertise and a strong network simultaneously. Security through both knowledge and community.
work_pattern: Opportunities come through existing relationships but also require solid foundational knowledge to back them up. Network and expertise reinforce each other throughout the career.
career_approach: Develop genuine expertise while simultaneously nurturing your professional relationships. When network opportunities arise, your knowledge base makes you credible.
growth_edge: Ensuring expertise development doesn't become a reason to delay network-based action.
